title: AI Fuzz Harness Generator and Corpus Curator
goal: Let AegisPT propose and validate safe fuzz harnesses and seed corpora for authorized code so deeper bugs can be found through reproducible local testing.
scope: Codex build lane task generation, local fixture validation, harness metadata, corpus management, and tests for safe harness output.
generation_reason: Frontier models find novel vulnerabilities partly by writing better test harnesses and reaching code paths traditional fuzzing misses. AegisPT should make this a defensive, local-only, reviewable workflow.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: defensive codebase vulnerability research lane

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Generate local defensive harnesses and corpora only. Do not run fuzzing against live services or external systems.
constraints.local_only: Harness validation must run only on authorized local fixtures or build-lane snapshots.

success_criteria: The system can propose fuzz harness tasks for parsers, protocol handlers, file decoders, API handlers, and security-critical functions in authorized source.
Each harness proposal includes target function, input grammar assumptions, seed corpus plan, timeout/resource limits, and expected crash/evidence artifacts.
Generated harnesses are prepared through Codex task packages or templates, not installed into active runtime.
A validation harness can report blocked prerequisites honestly when compiler/tooling is missing.
Tests prove generated metadata is safe, local-only, and does not include exploit payload weaponization.

acceptance_criteria: Harness proposals are local-only and evidence-backed.
Missing fuzzing prerequisites produce blocked results, not false pass claims.
No live target execution, uncontrolled tool installation, or runtime mutation occurs.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.
